account: The ITU account names the Dubai Digital Authority and the Dubai Digital Government Establishment as the submitting organizations, with KHDA as partner, in the United Arab Emirates. The organizations describe an initial pilot inside the KHDA portal and the Dubai Now app. The pilot lets parents search KHDA school data in natural language. The organizations state that the system returns up-to-date school details and saves time. They report no measured time saving. Educational improvements are unmeasured. They state that the use case is part of a larger product in development.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

comparator.against: the existing school search on separate platforms
comparator.before: Parents searched fragmented, static listings with no personal filters.
comparator.quote: The current school search experience is fragmented and relies on static, outdated information that lacks personalization.
